input.title: Import stuck "Storing from clipboard" when inserting trailing whitespace
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - m
    - x
- b
  - m
    - y
  - n

```

1. Copy the above text to a clipboard app.
2. Insert directly into an empty thought. 

## Current Behavior

Import gets stuck with alert "Storing from clipboard".

## Expected Behavior

Should import.
